effect_prompt: Fast side-tracking aerial shot. The helicopter races toward the left of the frame at high speed, its nose tilted down into the direction of flight, rotor blades a blurred spinning disc. The camera flies alongside at the exact same speed, so the helicopter stays in place in the frame while the world rushes past it. The product hanging on the cables is pushed backward to the right by the strong headwind, the cables angled diagonally, the product trailing and swinging behind the helicopter. Low clouds and streaks of mist at the helicopter's altitude whip across the frame from the left edge to the right edge. Below, the city slides rapidly to the right, new buildings constantly entering from the left edge. Strong horizontal motion blur on the background, helicopter and product remain sharp. Photorealistic high-speed aerial action footage.
